$comment: Provenance for every third-party image shipped in this repo. Anything added to public/ that Bacha did not generate itself must be recorded here.

tokenLogos.usage: Project logos are used nominatively, to identify the token a reward consists of. Each remains the trademark of its respective project. Bacha is not affiliated with, endorsed by or operated by any of them.
tokenLogos.retrievedVia: CoinGecko public coin API (api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/{id}), image.large field

photography.note: All stock photography was removed from the product. A photograph, however well licensed, broke the premise that every object on the page belongs to one hardware universe — so every photographic asset was replaced with generated isometric artwork in the Bacha art language. No third-party photography ships.

generatedArt.usage: Original artwork generated for this project via the OpenAI Images API, or the committed SVG fallbacks used when no API key is configured.

chainBranding.usage: The BNB Chain mark and wordmark are used nominatively, to identify the chain Bacha runs on and to attribute it in the footer. BNB Chain is a trademark of its owners. Bacha is an independent project and is not operated, endorsed or sponsored by BNB Chain or Binance, and the site never states or implies otherwise.

files.description: React components; geometry unmodified, recoloured via currentColor
